description: Your favorite tools, at a glance.
layoutHelp: Compact chips keep categories and tools on the same row, wrapping as needed. Brand icons keep their colors; chip backgrounds follow the GitHub theme. Notes and your saved categories are preserved.
compactLimit: This compact section exceeds the HTML export limits. Shorten the category or notes, split a large category, or choose Category headings to keep everything as Markdown.
searchHelp: Search and select a tool, or add your own name. Use the arrow keys and Enter to choose.
destinationHelpAutomatic: New tools are grouped by what they are: React goes to {frontend}, Docker to {cloud}. Custom names go without a category. Tools you already added stay where they are.
destinationHelpGroup: Every new tool goes to {category}, regardless of its usual category. Tools you already added stay where they are.
destinationHelpUncategorized: New tools are added without a category title. Tools you already added stay where they are.
suggestedGuideHelp: These are suggestions. You can choose a different category, create your own, or add tools without a category.
newCategoryHelp: Enter a name to create a category and use it for your next additions.
categoryCreated: Category {name} is selected for new additions.
organizeHelp: Regroup existing tools using catalog categories. This replaces their category titles with suggested names; tool names and notes are kept.
organizeConfirmation: Organize by suggested categories? Existing category titles will be replaced. Your tools and their notes will be kept.
emptyCategory: This category is empty. Choose it in Organize new tools to add a tool.
orderHelp: Use the arrows to change order. The first position cannot move up, and the last cannot move down.
moveToolHelp: Choose a different category to enable Move tool. Selecting it does not move the tool yet.
toolReordered: {name} moved to position {position} in its category.
categoryRemoved: Removed category title {name}. Its tools and notes are kept.
empty: Your tools will appear here. Add as many or as few as you like.
savedDetailsHelp: These groups and notes came from your saved draft. You can keep or edit them.
categoryNameHelp: The title is applied when you leave this field or press Enter.
removeGroupHelp: Removing a category clears its title. All its tools, their order and notes are kept without a category. An empty title is already without a category.
